thesis: 截至2026-10-12 10:43 SGT，市场定价面临“中东交通基础设施袭击抬升能源与保险尾部风险、但亚洲盘初油价随后回落”与“周三美国9月CPI及周二银行业财报重新定价盈利和长端利率”的双重约束。Reuters周一亚洲时段记录Brent约103.50美元、DXY约102.14，均为当时指示性快照而非收盘；美股现金市场今夜开放、美债现金市场依SIFMA建议休市，因此不得把周一股指波动直接解释为收益率已验证改善。
dominant_narrative: 今天的新增信息与10月10日正式日报不同：10月10日至11日利雅得机场发生连续袭击，Reuters及AP记录大量人员伤亡和航空中断，但没有可靠证据证明沙特油田已因机场袭击而直接减产。10月12日Reuters亚洲早盘显示市场分化、韩国股市盘初约跌1.1%，标普500与纳指期货分别约涨0.2%和0.5%；另一次行情快照显示Brent约103.50美元及美国原油约90.73美元，和前一时点Brent 105.48美元并非同一时间，因此不能拼成虚构日收益率。美元指数约102.14。特朗普关于俄乌能源停火的说法尚未获交战双方完整共同确认，俄罗斯柴油政策也有美国国内法律争议；印度央行10月12日为三家国有炼油/营销企业开设特殊美元购汇窗口，对亚洲能源进口汇率压力提供局部缓冲。美国10月12日股市交易、债市休市，日本现金股票因体育之日休市但JPX部分衍生品提供假日交易。真正可检验的传导链是能源现货与运输风险溢价→通胀预期→10月13日恢复后的美国国债现金收益率，再叠加10月13日摩根大通及花旗财报与10月14日CPI。所有10月9日的市场收盘数值都注明历史取价时点，并不伪装成今天的实时收盘。

top_catalysts.event: Oct 10–11 Saudi airport strikes renew aviation and regional transit risk before Oct 12 oil trading
top_catalysts.what_happened: Reuters and AP reported deadly Houthi attacks and a repeat strike at Riyadh international airport, at least 12 reported dead in the initial attack and hundreds hurt; airline operations were disrupted. Verified Saudi oilfield production loss from these airport strikes has not been established.
top_catalysts.what_changed: The weekend escalated physical aviation security and retaliation risks after Friday US trading; the events are not evidence that a Saudi oilfield was struck.
top_catalysts.why_it_matters: Flight curtailment, regional insurance and tanker corridor threat premia can transmit to fuel logistics and inflation expectations even before upstream supply is impaired.
top_catalysts.transmission: Airport strikes and regional confrontation → airline routing/insurance and tanker risk premiums↑ → transport fuel costs and expected inflation↑ → discount-rate / airline margins pressure.
top_catalysts.confirmation: Documented airport reopening, reduced regional security incidents and verified lower matched Brent quotes would confirm physical-risk normalization.
top_catalysts.invalidation: Fresh verified transport attacks, durable flight closures or proven new supply interruption would invalidate a quick normalization narrative.
